## Scope check

This skill is intentionally narrow: it's the *anti-bloat refiner*. Please confirm:

- [ ] My request does NOT introduce a prompt-engineering framework (CO-STAR, RISEN, RTF, …) — those belong in framework-based refiners.
- [ ] My request does NOT add a heavy runtime dependency (npm, Python, etc.).
- [ ] My request would make the skill more reliable, more discoverable, or more useful — not just bigger.
